shortDescription: Manage Users and roles on F5OS based systems

options.name: expiry_status
options.description: Account expiration date. Value can be YYYY-MM-DD string or C(enabled) or C(locked)

options.name: role
options.description: Specifies Primary Role assigned to the user.

options.name: state
options.description: The NTP server state. If C(present), creates the specified NTP server if it does not exist, or updates the existing one. If C(absent), deletes the NTP server if it exists.
